input_binding.frame_set_rule: exact (video_id, frame) set from Stage 5.1 frozen predictions; missing/extra/duplicate = 0 required

execution.shard_unit: per video (166 shards, sorted video_id order)
execution.frame_decoding: OpenCV sequential grab/retrieve of needed frame indices; temporary in-memory frames only; no permanent frame PNGs
execution.retry_policy: max 1 deterministic retry per frame on model exception; unresolved failure recorded as MODEL_ERROR with CENTER_CROP_FALLBACK decision record preserved (frame identity kept)
execution.resume_policy: per-video shard files + status json (frame count + sha256); complete valid shards skipped on restart; incomplete shards recomputed from scratch; no partial overwrite
execution.merge_gate: expected frames = 51256; actual = 51256; duplicate keys = 0; missing keys = 0; extra keys = 0

deterministic_audit_subset.rule: sorted(video_id); pick 10 videos by even index spacing; per video take up to 100 evenly spaced predicted frames; fixed by rule BEFORE rerun; model-blind
deterministic_audit_subset.rerun_scope: detector rerun on subset only; compare raw candidate semantic hash + policy v1 decisions vs Run A shard artifacts

per_video_shards: raw_detector/{video_id}.jsonl (every raw candidate: box_xyxy, score, label_id, label)
policy_v1/{video_id}.jsonl (video_id, frame, W/H, source_timestamp, candidates embedded, primary, status, fallback_reasons, ambiguous, policy_version, model_error)
diagnostic_crop/{video_id}.jsonl (subject->9:16 exact-ratio diagnostic crop or fallback crop)
output_schema.semantic_hashes: sorted canonical JSON hashes for raw candidates / policy v1 decisions / crop diagnostics
